name: Sarrià de Ter (Spain)
description: Blue field with a yellow indented fess of eight teeth pointing downwards and a white wavy fess below.
history: The flag was approved on 23 October 1991 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 1518 of 15 November 1991; it is an oblong flag of 2:3 with a yellow fess indented of 8 teeth and two half teeth pointing downwards between 5/9 and 6/9 of the height, the indented fess being a canting sign (serra, saw), and a white wavy fess below.

features.role: indented fess of eight teeth pointing downwards between 5/9 and 6/9 of the height
wavy fess below the indented fess
